description_en: Retrieves the permissions of a specified database account at a specific level
description_zh: 获取给定数据库账号在某个级别拥有的权限
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-account-privileges --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1k5p066e1a0000 --account-name account1 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccountPrivileges

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account whose privileges you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查看权限的数据库账号名称
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The privilege level to query. To obtain the valid values for this parameter, call the `DescribeEnabledPrivileges` operation
parameters.help_zh: 要查看的权限级别，来自接口`DescribeEnabledPrivileges`
parameters.name: privilege_type

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by database name. This parameter is used only when `PrivilegeType` is set to `Database`, `Table`, or `Column`
parameters.help_zh: 根据数据库名称进行筛选。只有当权限级别为库、表、列时才可用
parameters.name: database_privilege_object

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by table name. You can use this parameter with `DatabasePrivilegeObject` to refine the search. This parameter is used only when `PrivilegeType` is set to `Table` or `Column`
parameters.help_zh: 根据表名称进行筛选。可以和库名称一起进行联合筛选，只有当权限级别是表和列时该参数才可用
parameters.name: table_privilege_object

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start at 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页含有的条目数量，默认每页20条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by column name. This parameter is used only when `PrivilegeType` is set to `Column`
parameters.help_zh: 根据列名称进行筛选，只有当权限级别是列时该参数才可用
parameters.name: column_privilege_object

PrivilegeObject.description_en: The privilege object, which specifies the database, table, column, and description
PrivilegeObject.description_zh: 权限对象，为库表列的三元组，以及额外的描述信息

PrivilegeType.description_en: The privilege level. Valid values: `Global`, `Database`, `Table`, and `Column`. The `DescribeEnabledPrivileges` API returns this value
PrivilegeType.description_zh: 权限级别，可以是全局`Global`、库`Databae`、表`Table`和列`Column`，来自接口`DescribeEnabledPrivileges`

items.description_en: The privilege name. The `DescribeEnabledPrivileges` API returns this value

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. This value matches the `PageNumber` input parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 页号，和入参的页号一致

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. This value matches the `PageSize` input parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 页大小，和入参的页大小一致

TotalCount.description_en: The total count of privileges at the specified privilege level
TotalCount.description_zh: 用户在该权限级别拥有的权限总数
